title: LiverClear: A versatile protocol for mouse liver tissue clearing
protocol: Harvest liver tissue from mice according to approved Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee protocols.
Euthanize mice humanely before removing livers.
Optionally perfuse the liver with 1× PBS followed by 4% PFA in 1× PBS prior to harvesting.
Fix fresh liver tissue (whole or individual lobes, up to 5 mm thickness) in 4% PFA in 1× PBS at 4°C for 24-48 hours.
Wash tissue with PBSA 3 times for 15 min each at room temperature on a rotating nutator.
Incubate the tissue in hydrogel solution overnight at 4°C in a 50 mL Falcon container, ensuring the tissue is fully submerged.
Place the hydrogel solution containing tissue into a water bath at 37°C for 2.5 hours.
Remove the polymerized hydrogel from the container after 2.5 hours.
Rub off excess hydrogel surrounding the tissue.
Wash the tissue with 1× PBS.
Set up the X-CLARITYTM Electrophoretic Tissue Clearing System.
Run distilled water through the system twice to ensure cleanliness.
Place 1–1.5 L of Electrophoretic Clearing Solution into the reservoir.
Run the system at 37°C, voltage 70 V, pump speed 100 rpm, and current ∼1.2 Amps for 20 minutes.
Submerge tissue in a buffered solution containing SDS.
Apply an electrophoretic gradient to remove lipids from the tissue.
Add N,N,N′,N′-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine (Quadrol) to the solution.
Turn on the X-CLARITYTM Tissue Clearing System according to manufacturer specifications.
Add 1.5 L of X-CLARITYTM Electrophoretic Tissue Clearing Solution to the reservoir.
Add 10–20 mL of Quadrol to the reservoir.
Place tissue into a sample holder and position it in the ETC chamber of the X-CLARITYTM system.
Secure the tissue in the chamber to prevent it from floating out.
Ensure that the chamber lid and reservoir lids are sealed securely.
Set the temperature on the X-CLARITYTM system to 37°C.
Adjust the voltage setting to 70 V.
Set the pump speed to 100 rpm.
Set the current to approximately 1.2 Amps (this will vary as buffer is consumed).
Select constant current mode on the machine.
Start the X-CLARITYTM system and select ETC Active Clearing.
Replace the tissue clearing solution every 24–48 hours.
Monitor the tissue clearing process, observing changes in color as clearing progresses.
Replace the tissue clearing solution every 24-48 hours to maintain continuous lipid dissolution and removal from the tissue.
Pause the run periodically to visually inspect the sample's state during clearance.
Stop the run when the liver color reaches a steady state.
Drain the sample chamber and turn off the X-CLARITYTM system.
Remove the tissue from the sample holder.
Wash the tissue in PBSA.
Store the tissue in PBSA at 4°C for up to 1 year (optional).
Treat the tissue with ammonium hydroxide for 24–72 h depending on size and composition, changing solution every 12-24 hours.
Wash the tissue in PBSA for 2 hours on a shaker after ammonium hydroxide treatment.
Store the tissue in PBSA at 4°C for up to 1 year (optional) after ammonium hydroxide treatment.
Bleach the tissue with hydrogen peroxide for 24–72 h depending on size and composition.
Bleach tissue with hydrogen peroxide.
Wash the tissue in PBSA for 2 hours on a shaker.
Place the tissue in a solution of 3% hydrogen peroxide for 24–72 hours.
Change the hydrogen peroxide solution every 6–12 hours.
Wash the tissue in PBSA for 2 hours on a shaker after bleaching is complete.
Post-fix samples in paraformaldehyde after staining to lock antibodies in place for long-term imaging and storage.
Acclimate the tissue in IHC buffer with SDS / SWITCH-OFF for 1 h – overnight.
Incubate tissue in SWITCH-OFF along with primary antibodies of choice for 4–7 days depending on the size of the tissue.
Wash the tissue in IHC buffer / SWITCH-ON without antibodies for 24 h, on a shaker at a temperature ranging from 25°C–37°C.
Wash the tissue in SWITCH-ON solution 3 times for 2 h each, on a shaker at a temperature ranging from 25°C–37°C.
Acclimate the tissue in SWITCH-OFF buffer for 1 h – overnight.
Incubate tissue in SWITCH-OFF solution and secondary antibodies conjugated to fluorophores of choice for 4–7 days depending on the size of the tissue.
Keep the tissue on a shaker rotating gently at a temperature ranging from 25°C–37°C during incubation.
Shield the tissue from light by covering the container in aluminum foil.
Incubate tissue in SWITCH-ON for 24 h, on a shaker at a temperature ranging from 25°C–30°C.
Wash the tissue in SWITCH-ON or PBSA 3 times for 2 h each, on a shaker rotating gently at a temperature ranging from 25°C–37°C.
Incubate the tissue in 4% PFA for 2 h on a shaker rotating gently at a temperature ranging from 25°C–30°C.
Wash tissue in PBSA for 1 h on a shaker rotating gently at a temperature ranging from 25°C–30°C.
Add 7.5 mM sterile NaOH to achieve a stock concentration of 1.25 mg/ml.
Place tissue in CUBIC R2 solution at room temperature for at least 24 h.
Change the CUBIC R2 solution every 24–48 h until the desired clarity is achieved.
